    print(max_difference)

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().strip().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    V = int(data[1])
    
    boxes = []
    index = 2
    for _ in range(n):
        l = int(data[index])
        w = int(data[index + 1])
        h = int(data[index + 2])
        volume = l * w * h
        boxes.append(volume)
        index += 3
    
    # Find the largest box by volume
    max_volume = max(boxes)
    
    # Calculate the difference
    d_i = max_volume - V
    
    # Output the result
    print(d_i)
